title: Next 200 labels from the 1,546 unlabelled windows
method: greedy farthest-first (maximin) over z-scored 26 regime features against the 160 already-labelled windows, with a per-factory redundancy penalty x0.5. Uses model SCORES only as descriptive metadata, NOT for ranking (Z4 uncertainty anti-correlated with true OOD errors, AUROC 0.349).
caveat: these windows are all inside the 47 already-labelled factories: labelling them reduces MODEL error but adds ZERO independent clusters, so it does not by itself make a certification claim possible (see N4.02).
